set.body:
Current evidence: TemplateSplit and fixed-feature training/held-out capabilities, receipt import, saved TemplateRecipeCodec and exact leakage controls are delivered. The documented CLI/guide still requires Rscript and FittedTemplate.method still names the R QR route. Native LeastSquares.fit and SurfaceDecomposition are now delivered by closed bd-01KYD6SYK02ZRV99MG7FX939ZS. Do not reimplement QR or close this ticket from OLS delivery alone.

Ordered residuals:
1. Native fixed-feature fit: connect TemplateTraining to shared Householder QR, preserving feature order, training identity, typed rank/arithmetic errors and explicit intercept/rank-tolerance semantics. Give the native method its own truthful identity; do not silently reinterpret existing R-labelled recipes/receipts or change v1 meaning. Update public guide, site-docs/templates.md and CLI to execute fit/evaluate/save/reopen without R. Optional coefficient import may remain interop only. Preserve exact (1,2), held-out 7, response-700 and rank-deficiency controls.
2. Actual learned construction: name and freeze one bounded training-only template/feature recipe and its statistical unit before implementation. Its fit capability must not receive held-out rows; record formula/weights/normalization, split unit, group exclusion, training digest and fitted parameters. Use existing map/template operations; PCA/CORAL/CCA and fitted density transforms remain outside the baseline. Independently change held-out coordinates AND responses, demonstrate unchanged learned state/coefficients and changed predictions/errors, and kill deliberate feature-construction leakage. Fixed-feature tests alone are insufficient.
3. Workflow bridge: measure template_similarity_cv and the lm paths of template_regression/template_multireg separately. Pin folds, matching/duplicate exclusions, baseline/source predictors, intercepts and raw-versus-normalized maps. Per-cell surface regression and held-out trial prediction are distinct estimands. Reuse PredictorSet/SurfaceDecomposition; fitted/residual maps remain Signed, coefficients need not be mixture weights, missing rows/folds remain explicit.

Acceptance: native compiled saved workflows, independent learned-state leakage controls and measured method-specific equivalence/divergence on JVM/JS. Robust/NNLS/logistic/partial-rank variants remain deferred under their recorded owners; this ticket must not absorb them. Full method/KDE matrices are related work, not blockers of the immediately actionable native fit slice.
Evidence gate: use the revision and backend locks in tools/r-parity/baseline.json and r-lock.json; new inputs/manifests are per-ticket, never edits to frozen baseline-cases.json. Record actual exported reference calls, independent analytic expectations, named numerical tolerances and exact identities. Normal workflows/tests require no R; R is an offline fixture oracle only. Exercise public JVM/Scala.js routes, typed failures and declared divergences; keep every failed/missing case. A function name or internal unit test is not cross-library conformance. New published laws require killed mutants. Update case evidence and PARITY.md only after measurement. See docs/TRACKER_REVIEW_2026-09-19.md for shared ownership and closure ordering.
set.title: Complete native learned-template and surface-regression workflows
